notes: Unresolved question (date_format): 'Effective date' is '03/04/2026' for every row and is genuinely ambiguous — DMY gives 2026-04-03, MDY gives 2026-03-04. No other date in the export disambiguates it, so the operator must choose DMY or MDY before effective_from is published.

'Tax included = No' and 'Tax rate = 5%' are explicit source statements, not inferred conventions; the amount is therefore emitted unchanged as a VAT-exclusive price with vat_rate 0.05. The 5% fixture rate is not taken from any real jurisdiction.
Currency is explicitly SGD, so the schema default THB must not be applied and no FX conversion is performed.
SKU values are zero-padded in the source ('00470001'…); they must be read as text so the leading zeros survive, despite the profiler reporting the column as int.

No source column supports brand, barcode, category, status, inventory, promotions or description; these optional fields are left absent rather than filled with guessed values. Status would fall back to the contract default 'active' if a default is applied downstream — that is a schema default, not source evidence.

tables.reason: One row per SKU (12 distinct SKUs, 12 distinct product names) with a single price list, currency, sales unit and effective date — a product master export with one embedded price record per SKU, not a separate price-list table.

columns.name: SKU
columns.reason: Header 'SKU'; unique per row (12/12). Values read as zero-padded text ('00470001'…'00470012') — the profile's int typing comes from numeric parsing, so the mapping must keep the original text with leading zeros rather than emit 470001.

columns.name: Product name
columns.reason: Header 'Product name'; 12 distinct values, one per SKU (e.g. 'SIM neutral 1'). Required product_name field.

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: Header 'Currency'; single explicit value 'SGD' on all 12 rows. Use the stated ISO code as-is; no FX conversion and no substitution of the schema default THB.

columns.name: Sales unit
columns.reason: Header 'Sales unit'; single value 'PCS', which matches the sell_unit enum_hint but still goes through unit_normalize.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Header 'Price list'; single explicit value 'standard' on every row, so the price record's required price_list is stated by the source, not defaulted.

columns.name: Net price
columns.reason: Header 'Net price'; 12 distinct numeric values, never empty (1234.56–1356.77), one per SKU — the price amount of the single price record.

columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: Header 'Tax included'; explicit 'No' on all 12 rows → vat_included=false via parse_bool. This is an explicit source statement of VAT semantics, so the amount is kept exactly as supplied (VAT-exclusive) without vat_adjust.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Header 'Tax rate'; explicit '5%' on all 12 rows, parsed with parse_number_th(percent_to_fraction) → 0.05. The source states the rate, so no default 0.07 is applied.

columns.name: Effective date
columns.reason: Header 'Effective date' with a single value '03/04/2026' on all rows and an ambiguous_date hint: it could be 3 April 2026 (DMY) or 4 March 2026 (MDY). Interpreted as the price record's valid-from date, but the day/month order cannot be settled from this file, so confidence and the output date are provisional.

changes_from_draft: /sku now casts the trimmed value to string so the zero-padded text '00470001'..'00470012' survives (draft used trim only on a column the profiler typed as int).
/prices/*/price_list now reads the source column 'Price list' (value 'standard' on all rows) instead of a hard-coded constant, so the value is source evidence.
/prices/*/vat_included now comes from parse_bool of 'Tax included' ('No' -> false) with default false, instead of a bare constant.

Added /prices/*/vat_rate from 'Tax rate' via parse_number_th(percent_to_fraction) -> 0.05; this resolves the draft's unmatched column 'Tax rate' and overrides the schema default 0.07 with an explicit source value.
Sell unit goes through unit_normalize so 'PCS' resolves to the contract enum value; no pack_size evidence exists so /unit/pack_size stays unmapped.
Currency 'SGD' is kept as stated: no FX conversion and the schema default THB is not applied.
Price collection dedupe keys set to the contract identity /price_list + /effective_from; root dedupe key set to /sku.

Effective_from confidence lowered to 0.6 pending the DMY/MDY decision (one clarification raised); price amount, VAT rate and VAT inclusion stay at high confidence because they are explicit in the file.

No source column supports brand, barcode, category, description, status, inventory or promotions; these optional fields are left absent rather than guessed. /status would only take the contract default 'active' downstream — that is a schema default, not source evidence.
The 'SIM neutral N' product names are treated purely as data; any instruction-like text in cells is ignored.
